rationale: Jawad brings deep fintech and AI expertise as a serial founder who recently launched Collaborative Intelligence, Inc., while Jai is a robotics engineer at Reimagine Robotics focused on computer vision and synthetic data—two complementary technical domains that could intersect around AI-driven automation or tooling. Both are London-based and could explore how LLM tooling and robotics systems might converge, especially given Jawad's background advising early-stage founders on momentum and Jai's open-source robotics education focus.
intro_message: Jawad Koradia, meet Jai Kumaar Ratadia — a robotics engineer at Reimagine Robotics working on computer vision and synthetic data systems who could benefit from your AI and fintech expertise as you build out Collaborative Intelligence.
